name: Tomas Tobé - Après le § 25 - Am 35
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 25a. Stresses that crisis protocols and rapid-response mechanisms must remain exceptional, time-limited and fully traceable; insists that such protocols and mechanisms have a clear legal basis, be subject to effective parliamentary oversight, ensure that all requests or referrals to platforms are recorded and provide affected persons with access to redress; rejects permanent monitoring or pre-emptive intervention in lawful democratic debate;
